verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI's own CLI accepts a natural-language instruction via `-q` (e.g. "Extract all product prices"), and adaptive crawling stops based on a user query. Users still supply the URL and structured flags, so natural language steers extraction rather than running the whole product. MCP integration lets external AI tools call it, but that natural-language layer belongs to the client tool, not Crawl4AI. Missing for 10: documented end-to-end natural-language control of crawl configuration and operations (not just the extraction query), first-party docs explaining how `-q` interprets commands, and hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
